critic.fix_suggestion: Apply a radial transformation to the window primitive array along the fuselage's longitudinal axis. Instead of linear X-coordinates, map the window positions to an arc following the nose and hump curvature using a polar coordinate system (r, theta). Set the angular spacing between windows to 15 degrees relative to the center of the fuselage radius, ensuring they follow the aerodynamic curve rather than a straight line.
